group.description: Eclipse RCP-specific concepts: classifies bundles as framework or application bundles, extracts platform filter (OS/architecture) and localization properties, parses plugin.xml extension points and extensions.

concept.description: Extracts the Eclipse-PlatformFilter manifest header and sets platformFilter, targetOs, and targetArch properties on the bundle. Labels such bundles as :Eclipse:PlatformSpecific.
concept.cypher: MATCH (bundle:Osgi:Bundle)-[:CONTAINS]->(mf:Manifest:File) -[:DECLARES]->(ms:ManifestSection {name: "Main"}) -[:HAS]->(entry:ManifestEntry {name: "Eclipse-PlatformFilter"}) WITH bundle, trim(entry.value) AS filter SET bundle:Eclipse:PlatformSpecific, bundle.platformFilter = filter WITH bundle, filter // Extract osgi.os value WITH bundle, filter, CASE WHEN filter CONTAINS "osgi.os=" THEN split(split(filter, "osgi.os=")[1], ")")[0] ELSE null END AS os, CASE WHEN filter CONTAINS "osgi.arch=" THEN split(split(filter, "osgi.arch=")[1], ")")[0] ELSE null END AS arch SET bundle.targetOs = os, bundle.targetArch = arch RETURN bundle.bundleSymbolicName AS Bundle, filter AS PlatformFilter, os AS OS, arch AS Arch

concept.description: Extracts the Bundle-Localization manifest header (typically "plugin") used for Eclipse i18n.
concept.cypher: MATCH (bundle:Osgi:Bundle)-[:CONTAINS]->(mf:Manifest:File) -[:DECLARES]->(ms:ManifestSection {name: "Main"}) -[:HAS]->(entry:ManifestEntry {name: "Bundle-Localization"}) SET bundle.bundleLocalization = trim(entry.value) RETURN bundle.bundleSymbolicName AS Bundle, bundle.bundleLocalization AS Localization

concept.description: Labels bundles with symbolic names starting with "org.eclipse." as :Eclipse:FrameworkBundle to distinguish Eclipse platform bundles from application bundles.
concept.cypher: MATCH (bundle:Osgi:Bundle) WHERE bundle.bundleSymbolicName STARTS WITH "org.eclipse." SET bundle:Eclipse:FrameworkBundle RETURN bundle.bundleSymbolicName AS EclipseBundle

concept.description: Labels OSGi bundles that are NOT Eclipse framework bundles as :Eclipse:ApplicationBundle, helping to distinguish custom application code from platform dependencies.
concept.cypher: MATCH (bundle:Osgi:Bundle) WHERE NOT bundle:Eclipse:FrameworkBundle SET bundle:Eclipse:ApplicationBundle RETURN bundle.bundleSymbolicName AS ApplicationBundle

concept.description: Labels XML elements named "extension-point" inside a bundle's plugin.xml (or a fragment's fragment.xml) as :Eclipse:ExtensionPoint and creates DEFINES_EXTENSION_POINT relationships from the bundle. Extracts id, name, and schema attributes onto the node.
concept.cypher: MATCH (bundle:Osgi:Bundle)-[:CONTAINS]->(doc:Xml:Document) WHERE doc.fileName ENDS WITH '/plugin.xml' OR doc.fileName ENDS WITH '/fragment.xml' MATCH (doc)-[:HAS_ROOT_ELEMENT]->(root:Xml:Element) WHERE root.name IN ['plugin', 'fragment'] MATCH (root)-[:HAS_ELEMENT]->(ep:Xml:Element {name: 'extension-point'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (ep)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTE]->(idAttr:Xml:Attribute {name: 'id'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (ep)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTE]->(nameAttr:Xml:Attribute {name: 'name'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (ep)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTE]->(schemaAttr:Xml:Attribute {name: 'schema'}) SET ep:Eclipse:ExtensionPoint, ep.extensionPointId = idAttr.value, ep.extensionPointName = nameAttr.value, ep.schema = schemaAttr.value MERGE (bundle)-[:DEFINES_EXTENSION_POINT]->(ep) RETURN bundle.bundleSymbolicName AS Bundle, ep.extensionPointId AS Id, ep.extensionPointName AS Name, ep.schema AS Schema ORDER BY Bundle, Id

concept.description: Labels XML elements named "extension" inside a bundle's plugin.xml (or a fragment's fragment.xml) as :Eclipse:Extension and creates DECLARES_EXTENSION relationships from the bundle. Extensions declared in a fragment.xml are attributed to the fragment but contribute into the host's namespace. Extracts point (referenced extension point id), id, and name attributes onto the node.
concept.cypher: MATCH (bundle:Osgi:Bundle)-[:CONTAINS]->(doc:Xml:Document) WHERE doc.fileName ENDS WITH '/plugin.xml' OR doc.fileName ENDS WITH '/fragment.xml' MATCH (doc)-[:HAS_ROOT_ELEMENT]->(root:Xml:Element) WHERE root.name IN ['plugin', 'fragment'] MATCH (root)-[:HAS_ELEMENT]->(ext:Xml:Element {name: 'extension'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (ext)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTE]->(pointAttr:Xml:Attribute {name: 'point'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (ext)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTE]->(idAttr:Xml:Attribute {name: 'id'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (ext)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTE]->(nameAttr:Xml:Attribute {name: 'name'}) SET ext:Eclipse:Extension, ext.point = pointAttr.value, ext.extensionId = idAttr.value, ext.extensionName = nameAttr.value MERGE (bundle)-[:DECLARES_EXTENSION]->(ext) RETURN bundle.bundleSymbolicName AS Bundle, ext.point AS Point, ext.extensionId AS Id, ext.extensionName AS Name ORDER BY Bundle, Point, Id

concept.description: For each :Eclipse:Extension, scans descendant elements for a "class" attribute and creates IMPLEMENTED_BY relationships to the implementing :Type resolved within the declaring bundle's class space (its host plus attached fragments; the host copy is preferred). Types in unrelated bundles are intentionally NOT matched. Common usage: extension contributions like <view class="com.example.MyView"/>.
concept.cypher: MATCH (bundle:Osgi:Bundle)-[:DECLARES_EXTENSION]->(ext:Eclipse:Extension) -[:HAS_ELEMENT*1..5]->(child:Xml:Element) -[:HAS_ATTRIBUTE]->(classAttr:Xml:Attribute {name: 'class'}) WITH bundle, ext, classAttr.value AS className WHERE className IS NOT NULL AND className =~ '^[a-zA-Z_$][a-zA-Z0-9_$.]*$' OPTIONAL MATCH (bundle)-[:FRAGMENT_OF]->(h:Osgi:Bundle) WITH ext, className, coalesce(h, bundle) AS host MATCH (member:Osgi:Bundle)-[:CONTAINS]->(type:Type {fqn: className}) WHERE member = host OR (member)-[:FRAGMENT_OF]->(host) WITH ext, className, collect({t: type, inHost: member = host}) AS cands WITH ext, coalesce([c IN cands WHERE c.inHost][0].t, cands[0].t) AS chosen WHERE chosen IS NOT NULL MERGE (ext)-[:IMPLEMENTED_BY]->(chosen) RETURN DISTINCT ext.point AS Point, ext.extensionId AS ExtensionId, chosen.fqn AS Implementation ORDER BY Point, ExtensionId, Implementation

group.description: Eclipse extension validation: broken (unresolvable) extension implementation classes, and host extensions whose implementation class is provided only by a fragment.

constraint.description: An extension declares an implementation "class" that does not resolve to any :Type within the declaring bundle's class space (host plus attached fragments). The class is shipped by the contributing bundle, so a missing class means the contribution is broken and will fail to load at runtime.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (bundle:Osgi:Bundle)-[:DECLARES_EXTENSION]->(ext:Eclipse:Extension) -[:HAS_ELEMENT*1..5]->(:Xml:Element) -[:HAS_ATTRIBUTE]->(classAttr:Xml:Attribute {name: 'class'}) WITH bundle, ext, classAttr.value AS className WHERE className IS NOT NULL AND className =~ '^[a-zA-Z_$][a-zA-Z0-9_$.]*$' AND coalesce(ext.point, '') <> 'org.eclipse.core.expressions.propertyTesters' AND bundle:Osgi:Analyzed OPTIONAL MATCH (bundle)-[:FRAGMENT_OF]->(h:Osgi:Bundle) WITH bundle, ext, className, coalesce(h, bundle) AS host WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (member:Osgi:Bundle)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Type {fqn: className}) WHERE member = host OR (member)-[:FRAGMENT_OF]->(host) } RETURN DISTINCT bundle.bundleSymbolicName AS Bundle, ext.point AS Point, className AS UnresolvedClass ORDER BY Bundle, Point, UnresolvedClass

constraint.description: An extension declared in a host bundle's plugin.xml has an implementation "class" that is provided only by one of the host's fragments, not by the host itself. The contribution is resolvable only when that fragment is attached, creating an implicit host-to-fragment dependency that reverses the normal fragment-to-host direction.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (host:Osgi:Bundle)-[:DECLARES_EXTENSION]->(ext:Eclipse:Extension) -[:HAS_ELEMENT*1..5]->(:Xml:Element) -[:HAS_ATTRIBUTE]->(classAttr:Xml:Attribute {name: 'class'}) WHERE NOT (host)-[:FRAGMENT_OF]->(:Osgi:Bundle) WITH host, ext, classAttr.value AS className WHERE className IS NOT NULL AND className =~ '^[a-zA-Z_$][a-zA-Z0-9_$.]*$' AND coalesce(ext.point, '') <> 'org.eclipse.core.expressions.propertyTesters' AND host:Osgi:Analyzed AND NOT (host)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Type {fqn: className}) MATCH (host)<-[:FRAGMENT_OF]-(frag:Osgi:Bundle)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Type {fqn: className}) RETURN DISTINCT host.bundleSymbolicName AS Host, ext.point AS Point, className AS Class, collect(DISTINCT frag.bundleSymbolicName) AS ResolvedOnlyViaFragments ORDER BY Host, Class

group.description: Opt-in: models fragment.xml descriptors and, as a project convention, flags fragments that have none. Not part of eclipse:Default because fragment.xml is optional.

concept.description: For each :Osgi:Fragment that contains a fragment.xml, creates a HAS_FRAGMENT_DESCRIPTOR relationship to the :Xml:Document and sets hasFragmentDescriptor=true. fragment.xml is the fragment's equivalent of plugin.xml: it contributes extensions and extension-points into the host's namespace via the shared classloader. Requires fragment.xml to be present in the graph (JAR-form scan, or file-scope scan of the fragment.xml files).
concept.cypher: MATCH (fragment:Osgi:Fragment)-[:CONTAINS]->(doc:Xml:Document) WHERE doc.fileName ENDS WITH '/fragment.xml' MERGE (fragment)-[:HAS_FRAGMENT_DESCRIPTOR]->(doc) SET fragment.hasFragmentDescriptor = true RETURN fragment.bundleSymbolicName AS Fragment, doc.fileName AS Descriptor ORDER BY Fragment

constraint.description: Finds :Osgi:Fragment bundles that do not contain a fragment.xml. This is a project-convention check only: fragments that contribute solely classes or resources (native code, localization, additional classpath) do not need a fragment.xml, which is why this constraint is intentionally excluded from the default group.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (fragment:Osgi:Fragment) WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (fragment)-[:CONTAINS]->(doc:Xml:Document) WHERE doc.fileName ENDS WITH '/fragment.xml' } AND fragment:Osgi:Analyzed RETURN fragment.bundleSymbolicName AS Fragment, fragment.fragmentHostSymbolicName AS Host ORDER BY Fragment
